title: Rank-Average Degree Bound for Graph Energy
summary: We prove that the energy ${\mathcal E}(G)$ of any simple graph $G$ of order $n\ge5$ satisfies \[ {\mathcal E}\ge r(G)+\bar d(G)-1, \] where $r(G)$ and $\bar d(G)$ denote, respectively, the rank of the adjacency matrix and the average degree of $G$. We also characterize all extremal graphs.
